title: Probing the hierarchical dynamics of DNA-sperm nuclear transition protein complex through fuzzy interaction and mesoscale condensation
authors: Shangqiang Xie; Congran Yue; Sheng Ye; Zhenlu Li
one_liner_zh: 该文结合计算模拟与实验，研究TNP1蛋白与DNA的模糊互作及介观凝聚动态，属于蛋白质-DNA互作机制建模，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Nuclear transition protein TNP1 is a crucial player mediating histone-protamine exchange in condensing spermatids. A unique combination of intrinsic disorder and multivalent properties turns TNP1 into an ideal agent for orchestrating the formation of versatile TNP-DNA assembly and endows the protein with potent value for vaccine design. Despite its significance, the physicochemical property and the molecular mechanism taken by TNP1 for histone replacement and DNA condensation are still poorly understood. In this study, for the first time, we expressed and purified in vitro human TNP1. We investigated the hierarchical dynamics of TNP1: DNA interaction by combing computational simulations, biochemical assay, fluorescence imaging, and atomic force microscopy. We analyzed fuzzy interactions between TNP1 and DNA at the atomistic level and assessed the influence of TNP1 association on the electrostatic and mechanical properties of DNA. Furthermore, the alteration of the physicochemical properties of the TNP1-DNA complex modulates its molecular assembly and phase separation. Our study sets the foundation for understanding TNP1-mediated histone replacement and sheds light on the encapsulation of genetic material by TNP1 for vaccine development.
abstract_zh: 核转变蛋白TNP1是在浓缩精子细胞中介导组蛋白-鱼精蛋白交换的关键因子。内在无序性与多价特性的独特结合使TNP1成为协调形成多功能TNP-DNA组装的理想媒介，并赋予该蛋白在疫苗设计中的巨大潜力。尽管其重要性显著，但TNP1在组蛋白替换和DNA凝聚中的理化性质及分子机制仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们首次在体外表达并纯化了人源TNP1。通过结合计算模拟、生化实验、荧光成像和原子力显微镜，我们研究了TNP1-DNA相互作用的层级动态。我们在原子水平上分析了TNP1与DNA之间的模糊相互作用，并评估了TNP1结合对DNA静电和力学性质的影响。此外，TNP1-DNA复合物理化性质的改变调节了其分子组装和相分离。我们的研究为理解TNP1介导的组蛋白替换奠定了基础，并揭示了TNP1在疫苗开发中对遗传物质的封装机制。
